{{Quote|Not bad, little Ewok, but I've got more bad luck for you.|A lucksprite, to Wicket Wystri Warrick, upon his outmaneuvering of the arachnid|<ref name="JML" />}}
An '''arachnid''' inhabited the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was a segmented creature with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]], four [[Claw/Legends|clawed]] legs, and yellow markings on its back. The creature also possessed two yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], four sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and could launch gobs of webbing from its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. At least one specimen with an appetite for [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] roamed a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] area around Endor's [[Cavern of Broken Dreams]].

By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the arachnid threatened the Ewok [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], who had come to the Cavern to coax out her friend, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], who was sulking inside. The arachnid emerged from the cave and pursued the Ewok toward a nearby chasm, a task in which it was aided by the mischievous meddling of a [[Teebo's lucksprite|lucksprite]]. Although the arachnid succeeded in ensnaring Kneesaa in an orb-web, caused in part by the [[Lucksprite/Legends|lucksprite's]] engineered misfortune, the Ewoks nevertheless triumphed by dropping a stone through its web and sending it plummeting into the chasm below.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Endor_arachnid_rear.png|thumb|left|270px|The creature approaches its entangled prey.]]
An [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] creature exhibited a [[Color/Legends|blue]], [[Hair/Legends|hairy]] segmented body that was divided into a head, thorax, and abdomen. The latter was large and ovoid and contained yellow markings on its dorsal side. A lighter shade of tail-like hair rose from its rear. The creature possessed four [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] extending from its thorax, each of which terminated in three [[Claw/Legends|claws]]. The arachnid's forward legs consisted of three pale blue segments while its hind-legs were composed of only two such segments; the first of each was marked by bushes of hair.<ref name="JML" />

The head segment was also largely blue in coloration, shaped by two large [[Eye/Legends|eye]] sockets dominating the upper portion of its face. Its prominent yellow eyes enclosed black irises and sat on either side of a tuft of light-colored hair, which was situated immediately between them and extended to the crown of its head. The creature possessed a jawed [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], which contained at least four [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]&mdash;two of each on its upper and lower jaw. It was larger in size than [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="JML" />

==Behavior==
At least one such arachnid resided in a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Cave/Legends|cave]] named the [[Cavern of Broken Dreams]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The creature was predatory in nature, pursuing [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Species/Legends|species]] such as Ewoks and reacting to their calls. The animal emitted its own snarling or hissing noises and could climb on vertical surfaces, such as cliffs. The arachnid spat yellow webbing from its mouth, which produced a sticky spiral orb-web that ensnared other beings.<ref name="JML" />

==History==
{{Quote|Wicket, you saved me, like a great warrior.|Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka|<ref name="JML" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{EwoksDate|appearance of the [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]]|[[Just My Luck]]}}</ref> the arachnid entered the Cavern that it inhabited. It remained there until it heard the desperate calls of the local Ewok<ref name="JML" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]]<ref name="EGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], who had come to enliven<ref name="JML" /> her<ref name="EGTC" /> friend [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] from a bout of depression.<ref name="JML" />

The sizable quadruped emerged in Wicket's stead and startled the helpless Kneesa, prompting her to retreat toward her companions, [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]]. When the latter two Ewoks approached Kneesa, the arachnid obstructed them with a quick burst of webbing, which billowed into an orb-web and blocked their advance. Uninhibited, the creature cornered Kneesa at the edge of a nearby chasm, whereafter a mischievous [[Teebo's lucksprite|lucksprite]] intervened and caused Kneesa to drop her [[Lasso/Legends|lasso]]&mdash;her only available means of defense.<ref name="JML" />

[[File:Endor_arachnid_web.png|thumb|right|270px|The arachnid discharges webbing at Teebo and Latara.]]
Dispossessed of her lasso, Kneesa fell into another one of the creature's orb-webs and cried for help. Wicket then appeared from the cavern's opening and commenced a plan to rescue the distressed Ewok princess. While the arachnid descended the canyon wall toward its captive prey, Wicket lassoed a nearby rock formation and formed a makeshift tightrope over the web. The arachnid noticed the nearby Ewok and attempted to frustrate his scheme with another blast of webbing. The attack succeeded in part; Wicket fell into the massive web but used the opportunity to retrieve Kneesa and rebound for the tightrope.<ref name="JML" />

The arachnid, disoriented by the resulting vibration of its web, continued to pursue the Ewok couple. The [[Lucksprite/Legends|lucksprite]] again manipulated the Ewoks' fortune, causing the tightrope to lose tension and swing directly into the arachnid. While the lucksprite was thwarted by the other Ewoks, Wicket and Kneesa landed on the cliffside, where they pushed a boulder onto the creature and sent it hurtling into the canyon.<ref name="JML" />

==Behind the scenes==
The arachnid appeared in flashbacks in "[[Just My Luck]],"<ref name="JML" /> the eighteenth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], which aired on [[November 22]], [[1986]].<ref name="SWC">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
